report:
Finding: No finetuning effect — Model B is effectively identical to Model A (a no-op/control).

Reasoning:
- Difference norms are exactly 0.000 at every layer and for positions p0–p4. That means there is no measurable residual-stream change between B and A in the probed context.
- The logit-lens “top tokens” are the same generic function tokens at every (layer, position) cell (e.g., ' o', 'is', 'it', '\n', 'in', ' a'), which is what you get when projecting a near-zero vector: no coherent domain/style signal and no variation across cells.
- Patchscope readouts show no effects (no distinct continuations provided), consistent with an injected zero/near-zero difference vector producing no change.

Conclusion: The finetuning objective was null (no behavioral/domain objective instilled); this run appears to be a control where Model B ≈ Model A within measurement precision.
